Test Case Title: Do not treat a Zinfi escalation as complete until it is available in CRM for triage
Preconditions: A partner escalation can be raised in Zinfi.
Detailed Test Step: Raise a case escalation in Zinfi and confirm it is not considered available for triage if it has not synchronized to CRM.
Step Owner: partner who cannot resolve an initial customer case directly
Expected Result: Escalation request is synchronized to CRM and made available for triage; an escalation that remains only in Zinfi is not available for CRM triage.
